refusal.condition: non-finite primal, direction, cotangent, geometry read, primal intermediate or derivative result
refusal.records: 64 pre-cleared 32-bit source-attributed slots; IDs 0..31 identify a non-finite field read and IDs 32..63 identify non-finite computed values for the corresponding field. Integer atomic stores make refusal deterministic.
refusal.admission: positive extents, lpt>0 for hoist, products fit i32, disjoint buffers, bounded topology and exact canonical inverse maps
refusal.host_failure_record: The binder builds the ABI-v1 record from the failing slot, source_id and launch.

transpose.order: Each input owner gathers distinct dependent outputs in ascending owner order. A local tangent with one basis direction accounts for repeated references. No unordered atomics.
transpose.inverse_geometry: edge_offsets/edge_owners map each edge to the sorted unique set containing itself and every forward edge whose edges_on_edge list includes it; cell_offsets/cell_owners map each cell to the sorted unique set of edges where cells_on_edge contains it. The scheduler validates both maps from the original fixed topology.

alias_policy: All primal, seed, inverse-map and failure spans are mutually disjoint; shape and allocation capacity checked before launch.

branch_record.meaning: Executed active helper predicate counts by source slot and false/true arm; slots for fixed index and configuration decisions are reserved and remain zero.
branch_record.admission: Each executed arm count must fit u32; zero counters before every launch.

polynomial_degree_reason: With fixed topology and a fixed helper branch record, rho_edge multiplies the sum of weighted u*pv and reference_u*f_edge products, giving degree at most three in active fields; the remaining terms are at most quadratic (tree/src/hexcore/cuda_dynamics_v841.py:65).

cotangent_lifetime.scheduler: Copy incoming output cotangent to the saved, disjoint snapshot immediately before the adjoint launch.
cotangent_lifetime.read: Only the immutable snapshot is read by the gather.
cotangent_lifetime.write: The disjoint incoming output cotangent is set to exact +0 for every overwritten element.
cotangent_lifetime.alias: The snapshot, consumed output cotangent, primal inputs and accumulating input cotangents must be mutually disjoint.
